publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The paper investigates the feasibility of implementing computer and multimedia technology in the instruction of E-commerce English. It is necessary for teachers to integrate computer and multimedia technology into the instruction of E-commerce English since computer and multimedia technology has become an indispensable part in present classroom teaching. Then, the paper discusses the advantages of computer and multimedia technology in the instruction of E-commerce English as well as the ways how to implement the computer and multimedia technology into classroom teaching. In addition, the paper also explores the problems existed in the utilization of computer and multimedia technology in the process of E-commerce English instruction.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between the economic development and DCS location in an industry city
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The freight transportation is the most important part of the transportation system in an industry city. In this paper we tried to find the relationship between the economic development and location of DCs in an Industry city. First a model to determine the DCs location with the growing GDP was built. And then we would analyze the numerical example by ArcGIS.

articleTitle: Research on knowledge-sharing mechanism in enterprise group
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In the era of knowledge economy, knowledge becomes not only the primary factor that leads enterprises to success, but also the motivation that enterprises carry out innovation. Effective knowledge-sharing mechanism can help the member in an enterprise group learn from itself and others so as to achieve an ideal goal of the organization. Basing on exploring the knowledge-sharing process in the enterprise groups and analyzing the problems existing in knowledge-sharing mechanism, this paper puts forward suggestions for enterprise groups to build up knowledge-sharing mechanism.

articleTitle: Customer experience oriented service quality management
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Realizing the close connection between Customer Experience (CE) and profitability, the communications industry has been placing more and more attention to CE and Quality of Experience (QoE). The traditional Service Quality Management mainly focusing on Quality of Service (QoS) aspect no longer satisfies service providers' demand for taking the quality perceived by the customer into consideration. And it's in such conditions that Customer Experience Management (CEM) has been promoted as a solution. This paper first explores a few of the key concepts of CEM in telecom industry, then the recent studies of CEM models/frameworks are presented, and finally the evaluation approaches for Quality of Experience (QoE).

articleTitle: Based on the electronic commerce environment of the search engine marketing
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Search engine marketing is a new kind of Internet marketing form. Search engine marketing has done is comprehensive and effective use of the search engine network marketing and promotion, its most main work is through the website optimization, make the web page at key words the top of search results, use the opportunity to search information users as far as possible will marketing information to target users, so as to achieve the display and promote the brand the purpose of sales. Search engine marketing network marketing is the main means, for the website promotion, network brand and product promotion, online sales has obvious effect, but the search engine marketing is a is still not fully mature market, search engine optimization market didn't also too many standard, which eventually led to the confusion of the industry. This article from the search engine marketing theory basis of, this paper introduces the concept of the search engine marketing, goal level principle, as well as the basic method of the search engines; Then the domestic search engine marketing market development present situation, and finally discusses the our country enterprise conduct search engine marketing met of some problems and the lead to the reasons, and puts forward the corresponding countermeasures.

articleTitle: The development of the library under the cloud computing era
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Cloud computing is a new IT resources model with the distributed computing, grid computing, parallel computing and the Internet, which can provide the users with dynamic, scalable IT computing resources services. This article is based on the cloud computing era, with the introduction of the trends in the cloud computing library era. It can strive to objectively reflect the library and promote the current progress and future trends of cloud computing practical and theoretical aspects to provide a reference for future research.

articleTitle: The evaluation of the regional competitiveness on highway logistics in China
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In the light of the search data of seventeen indexes about the highway transportation competence of thirty one provinces of China in 2009, this paper measures the development situation in each administrative region and makes a comparison about the competence of these districts. Meanwhile, five main influencing factors are found out, and the regional disequilibrium in highway transportation development is proved. Base on this, the paper makes several countermeasure suggestions on it.

articleTitle: The improvement of Projection Pursuit Classification model and the application in evaluating water resources carrying capacity
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In view of the uncertainty of indexes for evaluating water resources carrying capacity, to resolve the incompatibility of the results of evaluating water resources carrying capacity, and to raise the distinguishment of the model of evaluating water resources carrying capacity, an effective and general model-Projection Pursuit Classification model is suggested. The density window breadth R is the window way radius that solves the partial density, it is determined by the characteristic of the sample datum, and it is mainly determined by trying to calculate or experience, which lacks theoretical basis, this article improves the density window breadth R of the model in theory, it deduces and acquires the empirical formula of calculation, making the model more scientific and stable. It adopts Real Coding based on Accelerating Genetic Algorithm to find the best projective direction, at the same time, uses the datum of the best projective direction to research the level of the influence of each factor to water resources carrying capacity, the classification results which accord with the fact are gained, which provide the decision proof of water resources carrying capacity.

Author Keywords: Real Coding based on Accelerating Genetic Algorithm

articleTitle: Prediction of landscape dynamic changes in Shangri-la County based on Markov process model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: We were studied the changes of landscape patterns in Shangri-la County by using GIS, RS, GPS techniques and TM images of 1990 and 2006, and established the Shangri-la County landscape classification system, and forecasted dynamic changes of the future landscape in the area. The result indicates landscape in the Shangri-la County was primarily temperature coniferous forest and shrub and meadows, with other landscape patches embedded. In 1990-2006, the most transfers among landscape types were between temperature coniferous forest, shrub and meadows and hard leaves broad-leaved forest, the largest rise were town land and farmland. In the support of GIS Markov model forecast indicates human interference to the regional influence will further strengthen in the next 16 years, urban land and farmland area will continue to increase, semi-humid evergreen broad-leaved forest area will decrease constantly, whole landscape tend to be fragmentation, the ecological environment will be received serious influence by human activities in the study area.

articleTitle: The research and application of the creation PDF document based on the iTextSharp
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: PDF (Portable Document Format) has undoubtedly become the new standard of electronic text industry for its high basis, full-featured and advantages to all other popular text format. We can use the third-party controls iTextSharp to generate the PDF documents, and it is more flexible to deal with pictures, tables, charts, and words' format. Practice has proved that, using iTextSharp open source control project allows us to complete the generation of PDF files, and it is particularly suitable for the PDF document with flexible layout.

Author Keywords: the method of generation PDF document

articleTitle: Graph-based model for lexical category acquisition
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: We present a novel approach for discovering word categories, sets of words sharing a significant aspect of distributional context. We determine symmetric similarity of word pair, lexical category is then created based on graph-partitioning method. We train our model on a corpus of child-directed speech from CHILDES and show that the model successful learns word categories. Furthermore, a number of different measures have been proposed for evaluating computational models of category acquisition. In this paper, we propose a new measure that meets three criteria: informativeness, diversity and purity.

articleTitle: The research on coordination of Supply Chain system with uncertain demandf
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In this paper, we considered the problem that the uncertain demands will lead to the stock shortage in decentralized Supply Chain systems, analyzed the game theory in the decentralize control Supply Chain system between a manufacture and some suppliers, and coordinated system by some mechanisms. The result indicated that the decentralize Supply Chain system can be coordinated by negotiating transport costs to confirm delivery quantity, and mechanism of share profit. The profit of system also can be promoted with the suppliers' processes synchronization, and decentralized Supply Chain system can gain the system profit same as that of centralized system.

articleTitle: Construction and implementation of virtual campus cruise system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Constructing a virtual campus is an objective requirement of modern teaching. In this paper, we use OpenGL and VC++ in the construction, along with CAD modeling and 3DS MAX polygon modeling, and realize several functions: virtual campus cruise, a bird's eye perspective and introductions of buildings in real time, which lays a good foundation of the digitization of buildings.

articleTitle: All-round reform drawing courses by computer technology
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The thesis demonstrates a teaching reform system of drawing courses on the basis of 3d modeling, which provides the characteristics of the reformation system of drawing courses, analyzes the features and innovation thereof and concludes the practical achievements in teaching reform with the aim of training students with the capabilities of 3d designing and 2d expression.

articleTitle: A study on vertical restraints in triple-play market of China
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper examines vertical restraints in the triple-play industry of China. In China, there are cable group and telecom group. Most of the high quilty program producers are under the control of cable operators; there are a little program producers who are willing to cooperate with telecom operators, and they are always small and weak. So cable group has market power and the incentives to impose vertical restraints in this market. In order make competition to be fairer, our suggestion to the regulators is to separate TV channels from the cable operators.

articleTitle: The convergence analysis for a deformed Newton method with three orders in Banach space
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: We establish the Newton-Kantorovich convergence theorem for a deformed Newton methods in Banach space by using three orders majorizing function, which is used to solve the nonlinear operator equation. We also present the error estimate. Finally, some examples are provided to show the application of our theorem.

articleTitle: Data normalization for DNA methylation profiles of cancer genomes
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: For DNA methylation data, many researchers believe that current normalization methods may distort the real difference between the methylation signals for normal and cancer samples. In this paper, using six methylation datasets for three cancer types, we found almost all of the differentially methylated (DM) genes detected in both the Quantile-normalized data and non-normalized data show consistent methylation states. In each dataset, more DM genes could be found in the Quantile-normalized data than in the non-normalized data. We showed that, for each dataset, the DM genes additionally selected in the Quantile-normalized data showed significantly consistent methylation states in another independent dataset for the same cancer, indicating that these extra DM genes are effective biological signals. Hence, the Quantile normalization method can be applied to normalize methylation data to increase the power of detecting DM genes. However, in some datasets, the methylation states of about 1% of DM genes selected in the Quantile-normalized data are opposite to those in the non-normalized data and we must filter out these false DM genes.

articleTitle: A methodological framework for vulnerability analysis of critical infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The infrastructure systems of power, natural gas, potable water are important parts of lifeline systems. As the complexity the systems are unavoidably disturbed by external and internal perturbations and may cause great disruptions, amplifying negative consequences. Reliability and vulnerability analysis of critical infrastructures for security considerations has become an important subject and some achievements have been acquired on this area. Since different infrastructure systems have different structures and operation mechanisms. A framework of analysis is necessary and seems to be needed. This paper takes power transmission network in a major city of China as example and develops a framework for the analysis of the vulnerability of the power network.

articleTitle: Development of the equipment overhaul management system based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper dissertated the significance and developing objective of the Equipment Overhaul Management System (EOMS), with analyzing the realistic problems in equipment overhaul management of People's Liberation Army (PLA). It described the design objective of system, analysed system business flow, built system construction from two sides, software and hardware, and introduced the key technology and development platform for system implementation. EOMS can guarantee rational employment of overhaul budget effectively.

articleTitle: Practical applications and considerations of teaching information systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The paper discusses practical reasons that lead to difficulties in achieving desired results when teaching information systems (TIS) are applied in practices. A component model and an acceptance model for effective teaching activities are provided. Discussions focus on system design, cognitive load, teacher acceptance, learner acceptance, and systematical approaches in practical applications. It is the key for successful applications of a TIS that the system, the learner, and the teacher are truly integrated to each other.

articleTitle: Research and application of a karst ground collapse risk assessment information system in Shenzhen Universiade Center (China)
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: To ensure the project safety of Shenzhen Universiade Center and normal use of the facilities, it's necessary to study the distribution rules of karst and predict the risks of Karst ground Collapse to provide a reference for prevention and control measures. With the support of MAPGIS software, a risk assessment information system of karst ground collapse in Shenzhen Universiade Center was researched and developed, which realized the automated process from basic data input to the result assessment of karst ground collapse. System functions include data input and output, data query, database generation assessment, model parameter calculations assessment, model features assessment, and result mapping assessment. The paper analyzed all possible factors that may affect karst ground collapse and obtained six important factors - distribution of dissoluble rock, cover thickness, groundwater level, karst development degree, building importance and structure. The weight coefficients of three grades of indexes were obtained by using AHP to analyze the six factors. The site was divided into 6843 grids by the size of 10m * 10m. The assessment results showed that 1.461% of the site is high-risk area, 8.666% is relatively higher risk area, 23.805% is less dangerous area, and 66.068% is low-risk area. Such assessment results can be used as reference for follow-up processing of the site.

articleTitle: Design and realization of network-oriented library management system (LMS)
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The design of information center library management system (LMS) database and the realization process of system functions are introduced. The system is network library management system operated on the company backbone network and it consists of eight subsystems of book cataloging, book acquisitioning, book circulation, periodical management, standard management, data management, system maintenance and Web query. The technology mode combined the Client/Server with the Browser/Server is adopted, through which functions of computer network management and Web query of books and reference materials are realized.

articleTitle: Data engineering in information system construction
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Problems about data engineering are discussed in the background of information system construction. The connotation of data engineering in information system construction is described, and data actions involved in data engineering are classified into five classes: regulations and policies, planning and design, acquisition and processing, application and maintenance, archiving and monitoring. Actions of every class are illustrated in detail. The lifecycle of information system project and the lifecycle of data are studied as well as the inclusive relationship among those lifecycles. The hierarchical framework of data engineering implement is illustrated. This article provides practical reference for specific data engineering like data quality improvement.

articleTitle: Quality evaluation for artillery based on projection pursuit method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Projection pursuit regression is used to make model about the combustion chamber and total sound level of the combustion chamber in order to fit total sound level of An Aircraft Engine. At last the average relative error is small to indicate the model is better, so it is important for aero-engine design and reliability analysis.

articleTitle: Design and realization of test system for Thermodynamics, heat Transfer and fluid mechanics
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: As an important application of the computer-assistant education, the development and research of the test system has always been a significant aspect in the education reform. The online examination system is a hot project in recent years. Based on VB6.0 and Access Database, this article provides us a general description of the exam system for Thermodynamics, heat Transfer and fluid mechanics. A detailed elaboration on the main functions of the examination system has been given and the overall designing plan of the system has been proposed, and main modules and database of the system has been designed in details. The examination system provides an efficient means of evaluating the education and plays a significant role in promoting the socialization and modernization of education. The project of constructing the system, as proposed in the paper, can be widely applied to the online education too.

articleTitle: Constructing an evaluation model for core competence of high-tech enterprises in regional cities
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Since high-tech enterprises are the basis of high-tech industries, the overall level of the former decides whether the latter develops well. It also influences to a great extent the economic development of an area or of a country. In this paper, an evaluation model for the core competence of high-tech enterprises in regional cities is established to analyze the technological level. The effectiveness of this model has been confirmed through experiments in Zhengzhou.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of group animation path planning based on Firefly algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Based on the standard FA easily traps in a local optimum, this paper presents a method that the current particle choose the one in its visual field which has the best fitness as the global best particle. The experiment shows the advantaged algorithm has a better global search ability. The paper uses the advantaged FA into the group animation, the particle has good artificial intelligence performance, and can simulate group behavior in an actual way.

articleTitle: Comparison of several types of methods for solving constrained function optimization problems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Several types of methods for solving constrained function optimization problems are discussed in this paper including elite-subspace evolutionary algorithm (ESEA), multi-parent crossover evolutionary algorithm (MPCEA), smooth scheme and line search based particle swarm optimization (SLPSO) and Constrained Differential evolutionary algorithm (CDEA). Numerical simulation experiments show that CDEA is the best method. The approach can maintain population diversity and simple parameter setting and enable us to find the optimal solution within a fairly short period of time.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of warm standby redundant repairable system without being repaired “as good as new”
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper studies a warm standby redundant repairable systems with two different units, a repairman who can take multiple vacations and a completely reliable transfer switch. In the system, we assume that unit 1 has priority in use and follows a geometric process after repair, while unit 2 can be repaired as good as new after repair. By using the supplementary variables approach and the generalized Markov process method, some important reliability indexes are obtained.

articleTitle: Community structure in P2P networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Community structure is a very important property of complex networks. Detecting communities in networks is of great importance in biology, computer science, sociology and so on. In recent years, peer-to-peer (P2P) networks have gained a lot of popularity, but it is still quite difficult to acquire global statistical information. Studying community structure will help researchers use partial statistical information to estimate the global statistical information. This paper reviews some basic concepts, new progress, important algorithms and significant results in the current studies of community structure in P2P networks.

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact of electronic commerce on the international trade
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: As the economy continuing to develop, the communication and information technology was increased gradually and electronic commerce (e-commerce) has been booming worldwide. E-commerce not only improved the producing and managing of the company but also improved the efficiency and decreased the cost. All these have brought great impact to the traditional trade. Basing on the profound impact of e-commerce on the international trade, this paper analyzed the problem of e-commerce in China's international trade and proposed corresponding solutions to the problem.

articleTitle: Methods and characters of speech acts in online shopping
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper provides a study on speech acts in internet conversation and behavior in the process of online shopping. From the classification of certain speech acts, it analyzes a variety of methods in the context of purchasing communication represented by distinctive speech acts, covering the validilty condition, effectiveness, obligation and social convention in different process. Speech acts in internet conversation and behavior, if conformed to certain rules, may contribute to the ideal and effective communication among participants in online shopping.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the relationship between ship steering and roll stabilization
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A PCA and BP neural network based method for evaluation of the performance of urban management
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper mainly discuss the BP neural networks based prediction and evaluation method. In order to avoid the drawbacks of the classical BP networks, the PCA method is introduced, based on which a combination method called the PCA based BP neural networks is proposed. Finally, an experiment on evaluation for the urban management is given. The results demonstrate the validity and feasibility of the PCA based BP neural networks. And the comparison shows that: the PCA based neural networks does have a better performance than the classical BP neural networks.

articleTitle: Study of methodology of E-business survey and analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The article focuses on the design process of survey questionnaire and the analysis process of survey results from the aspect of E-business marketing research. It discusses on the methodology of survey of online shopping and analysis of survey results by the means of describing design of survey object, explorative survey, design of survey project and data collection etc., and explores the statistical and management meaning of the survey results with expect to provide guidance and reference for the enterprisers in the field of online shopping etc.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Guangzhou urban heat island effect
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The brightness temperature data and NDVI data of Guangzhou urban city, what were used to study Guangzhou's heat island effect, acquired from TM image. The conclusion as follows: the high brightness temperature area include Liwan district, Yuexiu district, Haizhu district and so on old city, nearby Guangzhou train station rail line, Baiyun airport area, Tianhe passenger depot, both sides of Tianyuan road, Huangpu road and neighbor Pearl River road. (2) Guangzhou urban city including business center district, inhabitant quarters, factory district in the whole is the group of heat island, on the contrary, the suburb countryside take the green as the background; (3) the brightness temperature have tendency to reduces from the town center to the suburb, but the city heat island interior has the rich detail change characteristic; (4) partial heat island strong peak does not appear in the Guangzhou town center, but is concerns with the factory spatial distribution.

articleTitle: A employment mobility characteristics study of college graduates based on neural networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This study is based on national employment survey data of college graduates by Peking university in 2009. For the highly complex, nonlinear and uncertain characteristics in social science research, the study make use of neural network fitting simulation method, to better isolate the impact degree of gender differences in job characteristics and mobility characteristics in China. The results show that: Mobility characteristics of graduates have more significant gender differences: male graduates have a greater mobility than female. Except for job mobility, gender differences in schooling mobility, graduation mobility is 19.5% and 23.77%, gender differences in full mobility is reached 40.57%. Gender differences in job mobility is only 2.77 percentage point, this is mainly caused by female's "mobility inertia".

articleTitle: Constructing a model of shelf space allocation in product categories
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In retailing, shelf utilizing is one of main methods in goods display. About shelf space allocation problem, allocating product categories to shelf space should be discussed first. In the past, most researches only have considered how to allocate product items within the same product category to shelves but seldom studied about the product categories allocation problem. If product categories allocation is unfitted in retail stores, retailers will spend a lot of costs of product categories reallocation. In this paper, a Distance-Weighted Adjacency-Based is proposed to resolve the product categories allocation problem.

articleTitle: Research of wetland birds networking and method of collaborative epidemic identify
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The paper proposes a web-based man-machine cooperative method of identified wetland birds and birds epidemic. Then analysis and research the credible certification of networking. This system uses the WiFi Pan/Tilt IP camera to collect remote data in network. After the server's automatic identification, classification and treatment, through the mobile video technology to Web data in the form of reports, and streaming media services to provide online confirmed identification to complete certification for the disease to achieve a credible mobile identification purposes. Academic value of this paper is: System using the modern mobile network technology to solve the birds and disease recognition in accuracy, efficiency and reliability issues.

articleTitle: Simulation study on the fault tree of ship host
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The ship propulsion system fault will directly affect the normal schedule of ship, even endanger the safety of the lives. Based on the fault tree, this paper does the analysis on possibility of fault with Monte Carlo and analysis and evaluation on the reliability of system by fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method.

articleTitle: The analysis and research of the logistics industry integration in Henan province
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The logistics industry is the integration of transport, warehousing, freight forwarding and information industries, service industries such as the compound. With the rapid development of the economics in Henan province stably, modern logistics industry in Henan province has developed rapidly, but it is still in `initial stage', the extensive management pattern has not changed, many factors have restricted the development of logistics industry in Henan province, for example: the overall scale is small in logistics companies, the market share is small, the core competitiveness is weak, and so on. An comprehensive mode is proposed to solve these problems in this paper, which combined the mode of mergers and acquisitions, the mode of industry integration and the mode of the industry cluster. The feasibility of solving these problems using the comprehensive mode and what countermeasures to take are analyzed, which can promote the rapid development of the logistics industry in Henan province.

articleTitle: Numeric simulation and analysis of H2-O2 premixed combustion based on OpenFOAM
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: OpenFOAM is one open source CFD software, reactingFoam is the solver for chemistry and combustion. Cantera is a software tools for problems involving chemical kinetics, thermodynamics, and transport processes. So the coupling of OpenFOAM and Cantera can provide better simulation of combustion than the solver reactingFoam in OpenFOAM. In this context, we couple OpenFOAM and Cantera, and calculate the same H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> premixed combustion case with steady solver coupled with Cantera and different transient solvers coupled and not coupled with Cantera. Through the comparison and analysis of different calculations results of the same case, we can see that solvers coupled with Cantera based on OpenFOAM produce more precision result that solver reactingFoam does in deed, and in general, transient solver can reveal more precision trend than steady solver with higher time consumption.

articleTitle: Study of university student psychological early warning system based on Distributed Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Psychological early warning system is the important part of the university student's management. Most of those systems are based on document-based data mining technology. This paper presents a Distributed Multi-Agent systems approach, this warning model can better reflect actual the psychological changes of the students. Finally, the article discusses the construction of the framework based on Couggar computer models.

articleTitle: The relationship among some variables of Steiner tree problem
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Given a weighted complete graph G = (V, E; w) and a subset R⊆V, the Steiner tree problem (STP) is to find a minimum sub-tree of G interconnecting R. In this paper, we consider the relationship among the following 4 variables of STP: terminal Steiner tree problem (TSTP), partial-terminal Steiner tree problem (PTSTP), internal Steiner tree problem (ISTP) and selected-internal Steiner tree problem (SISTP). Firstly, we show that if SISTP has an approximation problem with approximation ratio, then ISTP also has an approximation algorithm with the same ratio. Then, we prove that the same result holds between PTSTP and TSTP.

articleTitle: Research on the application of software engineering and the multi-technology integration in the multi-media personal creation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Based on the basic characteristics of multimedia technology, this research comprehensively analyzes the common problems and reasons of multi-media personal creation in the multimedia technology and puts forward integration of computer technology and art design technology, integration of branches of computer software technology, and conducts multimedia personal creation based on the concept and method of software engineering. The relevant solutions given are specific and practical, which has a guiding significance for the relevant study and application of technology.

articleTitle: The shared cache reconfigurable method for low power on CMPs
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: As the multi-core technology develops, the cache size becomes larger in CMP(Chip Multi-core Processors), which is attended as the main factor in power consumption. How to reduce the power consumption with no influence on the microprocessor performance is an important problem to the cache design. This paper researches the related technology about cache low power and proposes a shared cache reconfigurable method in CMP for low power. First, this paper analyses the cache reconfiguration necessity by the static reconfiguration. Then add reconfigurable strategy during cache access. In the end, we gives the experiment result that the method can save energy consumption, while the performance decline is little.

articleTitle: A novel managing and reusing model for personal information governed by public sector
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Personal information in public sector has great social and commercial value. Therefore how to reuse these valueable information becomes an important research field recently. However, different from normal information, personal information have special properties such as privacy. It is important to design a reusing mode for personal information while the privacy and security is considered. In order to solve this problem, in this paper, a novel managing and using model for public sector governed personal information managing and reusing. For the first time, the protection of personal information is considered. Compare with existing model, the authorization and manage center is add to insure the privacy and security of personal information.

articleTitle: Research of factors affecting effectiveness of social network service
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In this paper we studied empirically factors affecting effectiveness of social network services. A model was developed and tested empirically to find out meaningful relationships among those variables. Results imply that SNS providers can increase their SNSs effectiveness by enhancing SNS intelligence which can be enhanced by increasing the social creativity and user externalization. It was found that social creativity is a factor affecting SNS intelligence and SNS providers need to provide intelligent and creative service for their SNS service users.

articleTitle: Auto unit emergency transportation support ability evaluation based on FAHP
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This document aimed at the troop auto unit emergency transportation support ability evaluation, advanced two basic factors-construct standard and capability standard, further more, organized into ten two-level factors, established a fuzzy AHP evaluation model, giving a calculation example. Results shows, this method is in line with reality and effective.

articleTitle: Measurement and prediction on periodicity of Shanghai Composite Index fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Forecasting stock market index is significant for government macro-manipulation, investing risk aversion, and corporate operating profits. This paper applies three methods, which are linear trend method, H-P filtering method and Band2-Pass filtering method, to analyze periodicity and predictability of its fluctuation, and contrast predicted value with actual value, based on the data of Shanghai Composite Index from 2007-2009. We find that each of these three methods can give a prediction on the Shanghai Composite Index within a certain range. In terms of accuracy, H-P filtering method and Band2-Pass filtering method have a higher accuracy with a better scope of application and reveal the predictability of stock index.

Author Keywords: Shanghai Composite Index Period of Fluctuation

articleTitle: A design of the vocabulary study automation system based on the integration of the teacher's personal WebPages and youdao online translation software
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This study aims to exploit the Web technology to innovatively enrich the ways, methods and devices of enlarging the students' vocabulary. It is firstly reported that most students of the researcher felt vocabulary affects their motivation and interest in English study so that the research designs such an autonomous system to help the students to grasp more words promoting their ability of foreign language application. In the thesis the vocabulary tasks and the theoretical basis are introduced and the key point in the thesis is how it is designed the vocabulary study autonomous system based on the integration of the teacher's personal WebPages and youdao online translation software. With the implementations of the design, how the assessment of the design is going to be done is also argued.

articleTitle: Study of task-based English language teaching using computer network
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The task-based approach is used the college English teaching, but there are many problems, which are based on the multimedia and network environment task-based on English teaching method. Facing the new century, the challenges of knowledge economy is in the context of college admissions. The multimedia and network environment task-based teaching English do a good solution to shortage English teachers with the reality of low efficiency. With the traditional English teaching methods, they are more multi-media and network environment task-based teaching for English students to foreign languages, which can indeed provide more access to language learning and language opportunities. This article aims at exploring the multimedia and network environment on how to better use the task-based approach. They improve the teaching efficiency for China's college English teaching in universities to explore a new road that is scientific and effective.

articleTitle: Development of turret interface based on WindML
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Under the modern information-based operational environment, display system is a bridge between operator and weapon. Based on this background conditions, this paper develops a turret interface based on Wind River Multimedia Library (WindML). In this paper WindML of VxWorks was introduced and WindML designing way of interface was discussed. The functions' implementation methods such as WindML configuration and building, 2D graphic drawing, characters display, region, window management and button control were given. Finally, the method mentioned above was proved in turret interface.

articleTitle: The research of sustainability development status of Hunan province based on the modified human development index
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: For the traditional human development index (HDI), it has some limitations such as the equal weights allocation in HDI and does not consider the depreciation of natural resources and its effects on environment. This paper modifies HDI by introducing environment indicators, so as to reflect the sustainability development requirements. Based on that, this paper calculates modified HDI of 12 regions in Hunan province.

articleTitle: Efficiency evaluation based on FAHP and Fuzzy Integrated Estimation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In this paper, because of the relativity and fuzziness of the index for weapon man-machine interactive system, the authors use fuzzy AHP to build up the evaluation model, construct complementary judgement matrix, make a consistency test to determine the index weight. At last, the authors evaluate the man-machine interactive system of turret by Fuzzy Integrated Estimation.

articleTitle: Method of weighted moments
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In order to estimate unknown parameters in probability function, we introduce a method of weighted moments(MWM), and discuss some properties of weighted moments estimators. The method not only extend the usual method of moments(MM), but also its estimators possess robustness. In addition, we provide the generalized chi squared distribution χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(n, μ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> σ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup><sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>) At last, the validity of method is illuminated by the simulating example.

articleTitle: Application of e-commerce in household electrical appliances industry
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Rapidly developing e-commerce has changed people's consumption habit, which has promoted online sale of large products like household electrical appliances. By incorporating e-commerce of household electrical appliances, 360 buy Jingdong Mall, Suning and Gome have made bold promotion and have broken out territorial borders, increased traffic and improved economic returns. This paper elaborates the rapid development of e-commerce in household electrical appliances circulation channels, points out existing problems and put forward some recommendations to solve these problems.

articleTitle: Construction and capability analysis of a small scale cluster system for CFD
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In this context, a small scale cluster system for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) platform OpenFOAM is constructed, then a turbulent combustion case is simulated on the small scale cluster system. After the simulation is done, we can draw a conclusion with data that the effect of three-dimensional flow field is achieved. At last, the performance of the cluster system and parallel efficiency are tested and analyzed.

articleTitle: A new efficient method of singular integrals in RCS calculation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: For the method of moments (MOM) based on RWG basis function, a novel method is developed to solve the singular impedance elements efficiently: directly conducting simple variable substitution to surface integrals and transforming them to non-singular integrals, thus reducing the integral complexity and computation. It is simple and efficient to use this method to solve the singular integrals without extracting singularity from singular parts, which eliminates the singularity of the matrix elements effectively and obtains high calculation accuracy. Numerical example shows that the new method, compared to the conventional methods, can greatly improve the computational efficiency and meet the efficient solution of complex targets RCS.

articleTitle: Research of the campus crisis management system based on web3.0
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In recent years, campus crises have occurred frequently, which is a serious threat to the stability and development of colleges and universities. In this paper, we start from real problems through reading literature and survey, summarizing the content, characteristics and types of campus crisis. Then we put forward methods to deal with campus crises: constructing the campus crisis management system based on web3.0.

articleTitle: Calculation of reserve requirement in reserve of talents model of personnel training system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In this paper, based on the “personnel training “and “introduction of talents” model, for the N system where reserve of talents starts at the same time in different regions under the same storage conditions with probability P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> during the designed storage period [0, T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>], the spare parts number M for N identical systems are derived. On the base of the same principle, a new method is proposed to reserve the spare parts at the same intervals. Examples are given to compare the two methods and illuminate the availability. This electronic document is a “live” template.

articleTitle: Research and application on mathematical model of quality variations in multidisciplinary robust design
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Quality variations are inevitable for any production process. This paper is aimed at constructing a feasible mathematical model describing quality variations in multidisciplinary optimization robust design. The proposed model is capable of dealing with the coupled systems and uncertainties. Based on our theory, we can give results of the individual subsystem variations with quantity values, and provide the mathematical model for the further analysis of the multidisciplinary optimization robust design. A NASA example is presented to illustrate the usefulness of our results.

articleTitle: Numerical weather prediction in Yangtze River Delta region with assimilation of AWS and GPS/PWV data
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Verification is performed on the impacts of joint assimilation of the ground-based Global Positioning System (GPS) precipitable water vapor (PWV) and Automatic Weather Station (AWS) data in numerical weather prediction in the Yangtze River Delta region. It is found that the use of GPS/PWV and AWS observations in Short-range Numerical Model System (SSNS) with three-dimensional variational (3DVAR) scheme greatly improved the predictions of rainfall and air temperature, with significant reduction of model "spin-up" time (0.55 hours) and decrease of root mean square error (RMSE) for 24h temperature prediction (0.30°C). Preliminary analysis is also performed on the mechanisms of the impacts of assimilation. The numerical scheme designed in this study should be of potential use for operational numerical weather prediction and related applications (i.e., chemical weather predictions).

articleTitle: Research and design of ceramic e-commerce platform supported by interactive design
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: E-commerce is an important development direction of network application, which will be the core of the human information world in the 21th century and have an unpredictable growth prospect. In this paper, the ceramic e-commerce platform supported by interactive design is a new e-commerce platform, which includes a personalized ceramic product customization tool, products' remote interactive design, online quotation system, products' displaying and transacting. The product's interactive design by using remote desktop sharing is as the core of this platform. This platform can solve the problem of demand communication for personalized products between customers and enterprises, make them together to participate designing products, and create an order production model with a combination of design and sale, and a new business model of ceramic products trading by customers' personality demand.

articleTitle: A brief survey of commercial robotic arms for research on manipulation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Presently a vast variety of robust robotic arms are available commercially, some of which are extremely reliable in precision and repeatability. This makes them an ideal tool for research focused on manipulation. However, there is a lack of an easily accessible comparative analysis that can assist researchers in choosing an arm that fits their research objectives. With an objective to provide such an analysis, this paper provides a comparative survey of the state of the art in commercial robotic arms - classified based on their price, performance and suitability for research on manipulation. These arms are categorized into four classes: cheap educational arms, low price industrial arms, research oriented arms and modular light weight arms. Within each classification, some typical robotic arms are analyzed in detail to provide an overview of the functional capacities of the arms in that particular class.

articleTitle: Bent leg walking gait design for humanoid robotic child-iCub based on key state switching control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Inspired by the observation that the 8-11 month old infant can learn to walk under the help of walker, we design a walker for the humanoid robotic child-iCub. A new gait - bent leg walking - is adopted to solve the problem that during walking the height between the waist of iCub and the ground should remain unchanged because the robot is rigidly attached to the walker. Based on the leg kinematics model, six key states and sub gaits switching between the adjacent key states are defined for iCub realizing bent leg walking under a given height. Within YARP framework, a controller is developed for realizing the algorithm of the proposed bent leg walking gait. Through inputting command from a YARP port, the controller can generate corresponding motor commands for iCub. The experimental results show that the proposed gait can control iCub Simulator to realize bent leg walking under the help of walker. This research provided a new gait for bipedal robot walking while keeping the height of the upper body unchanged, and a platform for the study of autonomous walking development, available in open source.

articleTitle: Energy consumption, economic growth and environmental pollution in Gansu Province: Evidence from 1990–2009
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper applies the Co-integration Tests, Vector Error Correction Model(VECM), Granger Causality Relationship Test and Variance Decomposition Method(VD) to examine the interactions and characteristics of energy consumption, GDP and environmental pollution in Gansu Province for the 20 years from 1990-2009. The empirical results show that there is a long-term equilibrium relationship between economic growth and energy consumption, but it is very weak and the beneficial relationship between them has not been formed; and it exists the one-way causality between energy consumption and environmental pollution, economic growth and environmental pollution, energy consumption and economic growth have significant positive effect on the environmental pollution, and the effect is increasing, but it is difficult to reduce the environmental pollution emissions in the short term in Gansu Province.

articleTitle: The performance for the product value chain model in marketing orientation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: It has been an important issue on how to get universities to better contribute to the innovation process, especially in the knowledge-based economy. No company can operate in every market and satisfy every need, and therefore companies do best when they define their target market carefully and prepare a tailored marketing program. We compare existing component technologies for marketing information systems with respect to industrial requirements. The requirements are collected from the massage chair industry, but our findings are applicable to similar industries developing for marketing information systems. The company needs to gather information about their target customers to aid them in developing products and services. All of these things are accomplished through marketing and marketing information systems. In this research, we developed a systematic procedure to identify decision-making criteria/performance indicators and a quantitative model to evaluate and compare the performance of medical technologies in Taiwan. The aim of developing such a modeling approach is intended to help enterprise executives (1) evaluate and choose new marketable value, and (2) monitor and improve the performance of existing products design. An empirical application has been conducted to explore and test the feasibility and applicability of the model.

articleTitle: Study for evaluating on-board power plant simulating training performance
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: With the development of power system, On-Board Training System gains more and more attention. The following question is how to evaluate training reasonably and justly, test the training results objectively, as well as locate and make up the deficiencies, to instruct training better. Aiming at the performance evaluation of On-Board power plant simulating training, this paper structures an evaluation index system, proposes an algorithm using the method of combination weight of improved gray analytic hierarchy process and entropy method to define index, and gives an optimization model. By multi-grade fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, evaluate the training results. The example proves that, for On-Board power plant simulating training, this method is practicable, effective and reasonable.

articleTitle: Metrological research on income disparity between urban households and rural households in China
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The problem of income allotment disparity between urban households and rural households in China has already become a new international problem of 21 centuries, is particularly noticeable. On the basis of the official statistical data during 1990-2009 years in China, the author of the thesis describes that the margin between urban households and rural households shared over 70% of the total margin in Theil Index by incorporating graph and text and became the most reason of income disparity of the Chinese households, displays that income disparity between urban households and rural households presented the trend of the gradual aggrandizement. The SPSS on analytical software is made use of, data are sieved on analytical method of regression, to make regression models through various statistical tests as metrological change tracks on income disparity between urban households and rural households. This text puts forward viable countermeasures on contracting income disparity between urban households and rural households from the macroscopic level in view of this situation.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis on new scheme of underground HV (high-voltage) distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Base on the research results of traditional harmonic direction leakage protection and combined with its shortcomings, proposes "Start at zero sequence voltage and its mutation, Alignment at the result of compared with amplitude and phase about 5th harmonic of zero sequence current" and take 80C196 as the core microcomputer application system. By selecting 6 kV high-voltage grid as a mine simulation object, simulating a leakage circuit of high-voltage power grid in arbitrary, the simulation results show the improvement of scheme's sensitivity and reliability.

articleTitle: Research of multi-configuration and whole working condition industrial boiler operation simulation training system based on IFIX
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The article conducts a comprehensive research on computer simulation technology of industrial boiler operation training. On the basis of analyzing the operating process of various industrial boilers and under the direction of multi-configuration technology of IFIX, an industrial boiler simulation training model is built, and a whole working condition industrial boiler simulation training system with multi industrial boiler model, integrating training and examination, and supporting large-scale distributed environment is developed.

articleTitle: The sparse-smooth penalty problem for additive models and its oracle inequality
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: We give a new sparse penalty for high-dimensional nonparametric additive models and propose an efficient and practical algorithm with concrete expression even when the number of covariates is larger than the sample size. Moreover, some simulation results are illustrated, and we also analyze the theoretical properties and sparse oracle inequalities of the additive models without compatibility condition.

articleTitle: The method for metabonomics data analysis applied on the urine of the rats administered with Liu Wei Di Huang Pills
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Data sets from metabonomics or metabolic profiling experiments are becoming increasingly complex, which are hard to summarize and visualize without appropriate tools. The use of chemometric tools, such as orthogonal signal correction (OSC), principal component analysis (PCA), partial least squares to latent structure discriminant analysis (PLS-DA), and OSC-PLS-DA make the data dimensionality reduction and interpretation much easier. Here we showed a system method based on PCA, OSC-PLS-DA for metabonomic data analysis; Furthermore, the loading plots of mass data were used for the biomarkers discovery. As an example, dataset from Liu Wei Di Huang Pills administrated rats urine collected by LC/MS/MS was used to demonstrate this method. The results indicate that PCA combined with OSC-PLS-DA was a time-saving tool for data interpretation and biomarkers discovery.

Author Keywords: Partial least squares to latent structure discriminant analysis (PLS-DA)

articleTitle: Understanding centrality-lethality rule from the distinction of essential party/date hub proteins in yeast protein-protein interaction networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The reason for centrality-lethality is still an intriguing question. The idea of party and date hub proteins has been influential in the study of protein-protein interaction networks. But the validity of the party/date hub distinction has been debated. Using average Pearson correlation coefficient in cell cycle, stress response and DNA damage, we confirmed the distinction of E-party hub and E-date hub proteins. The results also support the classification of hub proteins into party hub and date hub proteins.

articleTitle: Case study of application of interactive marketing in e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Nowadays, in the face of such large groups of users and e-business market, the development of SMEs in the field of electronic commerce is still in serious difficulties. The mainstream marketing pattern is just a unilateral coverage on the Internet platform, but does not play in full initiative of the enterprises. This kind of "sit back and wait" mind set will obstruct enterprises from communicating with customers interactively. This issue has become the barriers for the development of enterprises. However, enterprises such as Adsale and VANCL, using their online platforms, collecting a large number of consumers feedback to improve product and service, so as to maximize both enterprises and consumers interests. They have become the classic cases in e-commerce interactive marketing.

articleTitle: Research and practice on the prefabricated language assisted by the computers in college foreign language teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In order to improve the fluency and accuracy of college students' oral and written communication in foreign language and reveal the relationship between language features and oral fluency, a series of experiments were undertook based on the purpose of improving college students' foreign language general ability. Using college English and Russia textbook, setting the lexical chunks as the mainline and utilizing computer as assisting method, these experiments focus on repeating and imitating lexical chunks, interactive training lexical chunks under background and real situation, and improving the sensitivity of lexical chunks recognition and awareness of self-studying. The analysis of statistics of these experiments indicates that the methodology based on lexical chunks teaching can effectively improve students' oral ability. Therefore, it has magnificent significance to cultivate students' comprehensive language qualification and compound talents. Also, this approach is worthy for broadening among similar universities and colleges.

articleTitle: Using MIP with rolling horizon to plan China oil tanker fleets
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The pipeline transport capacity in the future is reviewed. Based on the forecasting value of oil import, we get the oil maritime transport demand. Further, we distribute the total maritime transport demand into the four main maritime lanes based on the long-term bilateral agreements. Then, we set up a mixed integer programming (MEP) model to solve oil tanker fleets planning problem. In our model, the charter and self-own tankers is considered separately. The fleets we used here are the most frequently used in today's oil transportation market. In order to get the planning results year by year, the rolling horizon was used here. The computation result is finally distributed into the four lanes proportionally.

articleTitle: Analysis and prediction of the total number of ice-snow tourism in Heilongjiang based on times series: A case study of Harbin
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper constructs unary linear regression model of time series and predicts the total-arrival indicator manifesting the Harbin ice-snow tourism market demand by adopting the method of integrating normative research & empirical research, qualitative analysis & quantitative research, which has significantly reference meaning to exerting great efforts to develop the ice-snow tourism industry and realize the sustainable development of the ice-snow tourism in Harbin.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of communication countermeasure system based on D-S evidence theory and multi-aggregation model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In accordance with the composition and task of the communication countermeasure system, its performance evaluation model is established. Positively combining D-S evidence theory with the weight decision-making information of the expert group, and according to the relationship between selected index and its influence degree to the upper index, we select two types of index aggregation model to calculate the system performance evaluation results. The model can reduce the uncertainty and ambiguity during the evaluation, so that improve the veracity and credibility of evaluation results. Experiments indicate that the model is feasible.

articleTitle: Study on the multimedia courseware with software engineering theory
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: As one kind of Software projects, Multimedia Courseware is facing the Software crisis too. The paper gives a way to solve this problem by using the Software Engineering theory.

articleTitle: Inverse problems in GPS positioning and numerical computation(I): Regularization method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper presents the results obtained in our research about application of advanced signal processing to GPS based position estimation. In order to improve the positioning precision of standalone GPS, we introduced the Regularization algorithm. They all get approximate GPS receiver position with the help of Bancroft method and computed observation error covariance matrix using algorithm of the Calilo data processing software. Regularization, which take into account characteristic of observation data and optimum choice of regularization parameter. The experiment results indicate that it can enhance the ability stand up to bad errors, which have profound significance on real-time and fast positioning.

articleTitle: A new feature selection approach in sentiment classification of Internet product reviews
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of the Internet product reviews, features which can truly represent the Internet product reviews can't be extracted just using traditional feature selection methods in sentiment classification. To address this problem, we propose a feature selection approach, by identifying product aspects, aspect evaluation words and modifiers, to look for more representative features for Internet product reviews. Experimental results show that only using aspect evaluation words and modifiers as features can help SVM classifier work well. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

articleTitle: The application of socio-economic data in the loss assessment of disasters based on case-based reasoning
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In this paper, an effective algorithm has been proposed for the loss assessment of disasters. First, we talk about the loss assessment of disasters based on case-based reasoning, and then, the application of socio-economic data in case retrieve and case adjustment were discussed, at last, we take the loss assessment of affected people of flood disaster, typhoon and earthquake, to prove the algorithm, experiment results show that the algorithm is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: The eigen-solution for the micro-structure and macro-structure in non-Newtonian material
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The research on the theory and application for the complex non-Newtonian properties in various testing conditions have been interesting and difficult problems, especially in the auto-crash safety engineering process. The interface structure change is concentrated at the boundary-layer leaving other part nearly unchanged. It proves the important property for the contact interface eigen-solution in the energy absorbing principal for the materials structure. It also agrees with the macro-solution in nature in the material world. In this paper, we use FEM to simulate the deformation of honeycomb (HC) structure under the condition of compression and contact to understand the related eigen-solution. After detailed analysis we may summarize the eigen-solution of the deformation. The figures show that, with different impact conditions, the honeycomb could absorb the energy by deforming the contact interface, while part of the structure that distant from the contact interface remain stable. This is consistent with the boundary-layer analysis and stochastic analysis in our previous papers.

articleTitle: The application of making Back-to-Back Stem and Leaf Graph using Excel in statistic
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Stem and Leaf Graph is a new kind of graphic method which is quite popular in showing the distribution of the data using data itself in statistic nowadays. Although there is Stem and Leaf Graph in SPSS that can handle single samples, Back-to-Back Stem and Leaf Graph remains a blank, as well as in Excel. This paper provides a thought of generating Back-to-Back Stem and Leaf Graph automatically with the existing functions in Excel, which has used in shooting statistical analysis and proof the correctness in any condition of rational. It can not only provide a new choice for users of Stem and Leaf Graph, but also fill in the blank for Sports Statistics using Excel as a calculation tool.

articleTitle: The desing of multidimensional analysis model for logistics distribution system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: As logistics system must handle mass complex data every day, this paper proposes the multi-dimensional method of logistics data based on the technology of OLAP, which means to research the multi-dimensional model of logistics data based on the main logistics objective, and apply the multidimensional operation of OLAP to achieve the multi-point analysis, for the purpose of providing various data analysis results for both business managers and decision makers.

articleTitle: Modelization of laboratory teaching management system based on UML
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of insufficiency in laboratory teaching management in colleges and universities, model architecture of lab teaching management based on UML is set up. The application of UML in the modeling is studied. A system requirement model, object structure model, behavior model, and system architecture model using ROSE are built up. With further use of SSH frame and SQL Sever 2005 software, this experiment teaching management system is produced.

articleTitle: Research on design of metamodel of weapons and equipments training simulation software
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: To solve the development problems of current WETS (Weapons and Equipments Training Simulation Software), a development approach of WETS was presented. The WSML (Weapons and Equipments Training Simulation Software Modeling Language) metamodel was constructed on metamodeling method, covering both function and non-function, by logical separation and description of every part of the system and relations between them. A domain-oriented modeling language is generated from the metamodel by the metamodel interpreter. A user model can be constructed according to WSML, source code can be generated automatically by the model interpreter and an application system can be compiled. Lots applications indicated that this method support model reuse and can improve development efficiency of WETS.

articleTitle: Analysis of structure of Chinese Instant Messaging market based on network externality
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Instant Messaging market has an intense network externality, which makes the structure of the market different from traditional ones. This paper will get the conclusion that the structure of Chinese Instant Messaging market has an characteristic of oligopoly through constructing a model of Instant Messaging market and calculating the Absolute Concentration Rate and the Herfindal-Hirschman Index. The paper will propose three competition strategies based on the analysis.

articleTitle: Non-teacher factors may affect teaching evaluation from students
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Many factors effect the teaching evaluation by students, some are individual factors from teachers, the others are not from teachers. The paper studies the effects that can not controlled by teachers. By using dummy variable device, we research the following factors' effect: number of class in a classroom, number of students in class room, teaching hours of a teacher in a term, type of students, grade and excellent course or not. We find that some factors may affect the results of teaching evaluation by students.

articleTitle: Research summarization on overseas M&As of China enterprises at domestic & abroad
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In recent years, with the changing of global economic situation, some academicians turned their attentions to the behaviors of overseas M&As of China enterprises. The research has different focus at home and abroad. This paper researched into the research of cross-border M&A by domestic academicians from the constitution and execution and evaluation and controlling of M&A policy, as well as the analysis of cross-border M&A of China by foreign academicians with research technics and the mirror of established cases. It also summarizes the advantage and disadvantage of the research both at home and abroad, and come up with the trendency and direction of the research of overseas M&A policies of China enterprises.

articleTitle: Chinese sports channel for the insurance industry marketing problems and suggestions
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Since reform and opening, Chinese insurance industry an average annual rate of 30% in the rapid growth of the important aspects of the financial system. The sports insurance as a new type of insurance growth steadily and rapidly. At present, it is an important subject of insurance industry, which is that how to promote sports insurance industry with a fast and great speed development in term of the guidance of scientific concept of development, meanwhile, it is even important for the great subject of sports insurance with a health development. It is a fundamental way to promote sports insurance can be coordinated and sustainable development which established a good marketing channel for the market from the development of sports insurance, trends, business situation analysis.

articleTitle: The futures pricing model based on optimal growth portfolio method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: After summarizing the characters of optimal growth portfolio, we derive the futures pricing model in a concrete discrete-time incomplete market using the optimal growth portfolio method. Then an empirical test for the model is done.
