The result shows, the prices predicted by the new model can fit the actual prices well, and compared with the conventional futures pricing model, the single-factor model from Cost-of-carry theory, the new model also has advantage in precision.

articleTitle: Research on recognition strategy based on six kinds basic word of C program
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Having converting the C character sequence into word sequence, this paper puts forwarded that C program contains six kinds of basic word: identifier, keyword, constant, operator, separator and comment. The way of the open word recognition by lexical rules and closed word by comparison of one word is first applied in this paper to put forward the identification strategy about the main features of six kinds of basic word and recognition technology of each type of word in the C program, which provides the basis for the automatic scoring system of C program.

articleTitle: Research on ERP investment performance evaluation about Chinesse enterprises based on DEA model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: ERP is a complex undertaking requiring considerable resources. However there are diverse views on its efficiency. In this paper, we attempt to look for an evaluation model for ERP investment performance. Based on Data Envelopment Analysis, we provide a theoretical study on the influence of ERP investment on return to scale and competitive power of enterprises.

articleTitle: An approach for metabonomics data analysis applied on the plasma of RAC water extract administered reserpine induced spleen deficiency rats
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Data sets in metabonomics or metabolic profiling experiments are becoming increasingly complex, which is hard to analyze without appropriate methods. The use of chemometric tools, such as orthogonal signal correction (OSC), principal component analysis (PCA), partial least squares discriminant analysis (PLS-DA), (orthogonal partial least squares discriminant analysis (OPLS-DA) make the data dimension and interpretation much easier. Here a system method based on PCA, OSC-PLS-DA for metabonomic data analysis was showed; Furthermore, U-plot, as a visualized tool was used for the biomarkers discovery. As an example, dataset from RAC water extract administrated spleen deficiency rats plasma collected by LC/MS/MS was used to demonstrate this method. As a result, PCA was an useful tool for metabonomic dataset dimension reduction, OSC is an powerful data filter, U-plot based on OSC-PLS-DA was proved to be an effective, time saving tool for data interpretation and biomarkers discovery. In conclusion, the a system method shown by this paper is suitable for the matabonomic study.

Author Keywords: orthogonal signal correction partial least square discrimant analysis (OSC-PLS-DA)

articleTitle: Consumption quota model of repairable spares based on fill rate
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: According to the three conditions that spares demand variance-to-mean ratio are larger than, equal to or less than 1, put forward the Negative binomial distribution, Poisson distribution and Binomial distribution three demand distributions. For the problem that the two-echelon spares demand follows the Poisson distribution, used the Negative binomial distribution to improve the forecasting accuracy. With the fill rate as the criterion of the spares ensure degree, formulated the lowest fill rate on the basis of the affecting factors of the spares consumption quota. In the given total security funds and the minimum fill rates as the constraint conditions, the fill rate maximization as the objective function, established the spares consumption quota model, adopted the marginal analysis to optimize it and compile algorithm. The example proves that the model has good prediction effect.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The design research and application of muti-park plant computer network system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The research of Chinese DOI resolution mechanism and development
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: DOI has been widely used in the field of digital information resources at home and abroad. This paper not only discusses the analysis of DOI resolution mechanism including the single resolution and multiple resolutions, but also prospects on the automatic multiple resolutions. Then it analyses the current development of the Chinese DOI system. Finally, this article puts forward some development suggestions of Chinese DOI.

articleTitle: Computer Technology in the research on the application of ecological architecture creation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Energy and environment problem is becoming more and more serious today, Ecological architecture as building energy efficiency and sustainable development of important research direction are being gradually getting attention and recognition, A large number of ecological construction theory and practice activities be promotion and implementation. However, ecological architecture as a contains numerous factors of the system, the dynamic design, construction, application and appraisal complexity also directly affect the application of ecological architecture. Through the application of computer technology in various stages of ecological architecture and to assess the rational use of system analysis, which provides effective methods and means for our ecological architecture creation, also brings practical significance to it.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of different conservation tillage technology model based on grey relation projection method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The purpose of the author was to use the grey relation projection method to evaluate the conservation tillage technology in western aeolian sandy soil area of Heilongjiang Province. The experimental field was elected in Dumeng Country Yixin town. The measure of the conservation tillage including covering film between furrows, integration technique of furrow damming and covering film between furrows, furrow damming, straw mulch. The purpose was to establish an appropriate conservation tillage technology model in this area. The results show that the four kinds of conservation tillage have different effect of water-saving and improve economic role. Their effects were that:, integration technique of furrow damming and covering film between furrows>;covering film between furrows>;furrow damming>;straw mulch>;CK.

articleTitle: Modeling split rate for private car in urban area based on STM
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: A car split rate model based on Strategic Transport Model (STM) method has been proposed in this paper. The model can be used to predict the car split rate in urban traffic system. It also allows assessing the consequences of strategic changes in urban traffic system. With in-depth study of the strategic transport model, the SCGC model (Service Characteristics based General Cost model) is built. Then taking service characteristics such as economic cost, time cost, service accessibility and comfort factor into consideration, the split rate model for private car based on the STM is proposed. With the residents travel survey data from 2005 to 2007 in Beijing city, the models are calibrated. According to the parameters the model is validated and the relative error between actual data and the prediction data is 2.47%, the prediction result is of high accuracy. It is proved that the model is accurate and serviceable.

articleTitle: Research and design of Web Single Sign-On scheme
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The thesis designs an easy to use, safe, efficient solution of Web Single Sign-On, referring to the design idea of Kerberos protocol based on ticket access and using Single Sign-On model of Broker-Agent-Based. In this program, the use of URL redirects and Cookie technology achieve Single Sign-On, can be implemented, and has a good application and promotion of value.

articleTitle: Research on the information security experimental teaching based on project management model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper analyzed the current situation of training mode in computer normal major, investigated and discussed the problem in professional characteristics, normal education and teachers team. Focus on the actual situation of computer normal major building of Liaoning Normal University, advanced an idea for multi-direction professional skills training and emphasizing information technology applications in normal education. This idea achieved good results in practice.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic programming model based on semantic
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: OGSA(Open Grid Services Architecture) is called the next generation grid architecture. We research the architecture of the Web Service, we also program a grid service in the grid environment. On the point of component, this system is exactly a multiple component, it provide service to external in Web Service mode. With the growing number of Web services, it is necessary to compose existing Web services dynamically according to service request. Dynamic composition service method is proposed based on semantic, according to user demand real-time change, convenient user programming.

articleTitle: Modeling progonostic and health management system for shipboard electromechanical platform
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Based on the layered structure of shipboard electromechanical systems, a hierarchical prognostic and health management system structure has been established according to OSA-CBM specification. Then logic and data flow analysis has been down for every layer of the system including decision generation, prognostic assessment, health assessment, state dection, data processing and data acquisition. After that, the system has been modeling by several data processers, D&HA (for diagonostic and health assessment) modules and a HA(health management) module. Finally, the shipboard electromechanical platform PHM simulation environment is built up to analysis the target of modules.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of the CSCW system model and architecture
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: With the development and popularization of intranet/Extranet and Internet, it provides vast development space for manufacturing industry. The computer support cooperative work such as collaborative design and collaborative manufacturing based on web is presented under the background. Computer Support Cooperative Work (CSCW) is defined that in the environment supported by computer technology, a groupware cooperatively work to accomplish a common task. The paper is focus on the requirement and environment of CSCW system and the construction of CSCW system model and architecture.

articleTitle: Research on the development trend of Harbin's ice-snow tourist market based on the gravity model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The important factors influencing the demand of ice-snow tourist market include the population of source region, economic condition, attraction of tourist destination for the tourists, and distance between the destination and source region, etc. This paper adopts the gravity model to analyze the factors which are difficult for quantization, make quantitative interpretation, and establish the prediction model. The result data demonstrates the validity of the modified gravity model in the prediction of the development trend of ice-snow tourist market.

articleTitle: Research and design of mobile office system of ZhongShan city for health supervision and inspection
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Standard health supervision by information technology is an important part of national public health information system construction, The paper firstly sets up the overall health supervision information framework and plans the application system from the global perspective, then designs the mobile office system based on object-oriented thought from On-site law enforcement perspective, The system consists of mobile law enforcement subsystems and data center subsystems, using JavaEE B/S/S/S architecture, realizes the informatization of the whole health supervision business process including on-site data gathering, business process approval and integration with other system; In addition, this paper puts forward the optimized mobile law enforcement business process for health supervision, finally describes the five support platform functions and core functions that data center provides.

articleTitle: The modeling and simulation of the frequency characteristics on deep-submicron fully depleted SOI BJMOSFET
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The high frequency model of deep-submicron fully depleted SOI BJMOSFET has been proposed theoretically and its frequency characteristics curves have been achieved by HSPICE software. Compared to deep-submicron fully depleted SOI MOSFET at the same condition, it's proved that the new-style SOI device has much better frequency characteristics and more rapid working speed. So it's a kind of new excellent SOI device.

articleTitle: A text plan framework based on XML
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Currently, text plan use approaches like Schema, RST, etc. In this paper, we put forward a XML-based framework that both Schema and RST strategies. The proposed framework use XML for knowledge representation and has three components: XML repository, XML-information-tree, XML-plan-tree.

articleTitle: The risk analysis and safety strategy on remote mobile payment
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the remote mobile payment process and risks and puts forward a series of security strategies to protect the consumer from the angle of strengthening of safety, convenient user. Then, it solves the problems of remote mobile payment by strengthening the client and the hardware encryption strategies. Finally, remote mobile payment security is prospected.

articleTitle: Implementation of the full function marine power station operation training and assessment equipments
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Aiming at the requirements and characteristics of the marine power station operation training and skill assessment in maritime education, the design ideas and development process of full function marine power station training and assessment equipments are analyzed. These set of equipments include four parts: the actual power station equipments, simulated power station equipments, power station monitoring simulation system and competency assessment automatic scoring system. They are based on actual and simulated devices and combined with computer communication. Practical operation proves that these equipments are practical, stable and reliable.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of GIS course based on SuperMap
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The application of GIS has outranged the original field. GIS education is developing flourishing today. According to the characteristics of the GIS course, we propose our course design based on SuperMap. All the correlated theories, algorithms, processes and results can be demonstrated and expressed by using fundamental experiments, comprehensive experiments and designing experiments. The problems occurred during the teaching are analyzed. In conjunction with our teaching experiences, the idea of course design, the teaching objectives, contents and modes are discussed, aiming to better teaching and learning performance. The purpose of these discussions is to improve the effect of teaching and enhance the competitive ability of students.

articleTitle: Research progress in teamwork
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Teamwork involves multi-agents collaborating with each other to achieve their common goals. Generally, BDI, DCOP and DEC-POMDP are three main frameworks specially designed for teamwork, which model the interactions and decision-making process from different perspectives, such as intentions, domain knowledge, or rewarded utility. Some novel progresses in the study of these approaches emerged recent years, including enhanced expression capability and improved computational efficiency, which greatly improve the ability to handle practical problems of these approaches. This paper will review these progresses.

articleTitle: Realization of key signal components based on STD
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: After the relation between components in BSC layer according to STD(Signal and Test Definition) is analyzed in detail, the design mode is used to realize the key signal components in STD, which is the base of applying STD to ATS(Automatic Test System) software platform.

articleTitle: Information sharing incentive mechanism in Global value chain
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Global value chain (GVC) broadens the international participation and cooperation of a state or an area. The model of information sharing comprehensive benefit in GVC is set up in the paper. The incentive mechanism and corresponding strategy in order to promote GVC performance is given.

articleTitle: Application of RAGA-PPC model on the optimal harvest time of Puccinellia tenuiflora
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In order to ascertain the optimal harvest time of Puccinellia tenuiflora in practical production scientifically, PPC (Projection Pursuit Classification) model based on RAGA (Real coding based Accelerating Genetic Algorithm) was applied. Projection direction was optimized and high-dimension data were converted into low-dimension space with PPC, value of projection indexes could be obtained. Based on these projection function values, the sequence of samples from the big to the small was gained, at the same time, subjective impact on weight matrix farthest could be avoided with PPC model. The results showed that the initial biloom stage have the biggest value of projection indexes, which was 2.2572, and its comprehensive evaluation was the best based on the data from 2007 to 2008. Puccinellia tenuiflora harvested in the initial bloom stage had higher nutritive value, higher output and lower coarse fibre content. This model offered a new method to solve the evaluating problem of the optimal harvest time of Puccinellia tenuiflora.

articleTitle: Design practice and standardization exploration on online learning system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper discusses the evolution of online system design orientation, introduce "user-centered design", "usage-centered design", "learner-centered design" and "Integrated design framework" then introduce the general process and process model of products design. At last, combining with the author's practice experience, analyze and elaborate the basic processes and standardization of online learning system's design.

Author Keywords: the design of online learning system

articleTitle: A new coupling method for nonlinear transmission problem modelling Coulomb friction contact
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a nonlinear transmission problem modelling elastoplastic interface problems with contact and Coulomb friction. To solve this problem, we present a new coupling method of finite element and boundary element by adding an auxiliary circle and derive a priori error estimate for the coupled FEM-BEM problem.

articleTitle: The application of TSVM in teaching quality evaluation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The management of teaching ability evaluation is the main part of the personnel training target, which is formulated by the school, this article unifies the practice of classroom teaching ability evaluation, research has analyzed the key technologies about the design of the evaluation index system, the theory of support vector machine, incremental learning and so on; it has established the Model of Teaching Ability Evaluation based on the TSVM, and applies it to the School Teaching Ability Evaluation System. The experimental studies have shown that this model can obtain more desirable results.

articleTitle: Research of simplification of dynamic structure based food correlation heuristic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the data for the food, this article constructs an association model for food. This model features has both the hierarchical model and mesh model characteristics. Simplified hierarchicalmodel, undirected ring graph conversion are be done base on that. It also gives the ellipse optimization strategies and improved heuristic search algorithm to find the shortest path. Experiment results show that this improvement process improves the algorithm's search efficiency and stability.

articleTitle: Pulmonary vascular tree enhancement with an improved shock diffusion filter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Filtering of vessel structures with the second order information is a fundamental basis for vascular tree enhancement. Traditional Hessian-related methods often suffer from noise pollution and variance of grey level. In this paper an improved shock diffusion filter is proposed to enhance vascular structures. By using multi-scale vesselness measurement as a regulation factor in the diffusion process, this filter expresses a high response to vesselness and robust anti-noise ability. The proposed filtering method is validated with both synthetic data and pulmonary CT data. The results show that the proposed method is robust with noisy image and effective in enhancing vessel bifurcations.

articleTitle: Intelligent power control system — A case study of the lighting power in communal lavatories
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In light of the demand for global greenhouse gas control proposed in Kyoto Protocol as well as promoting the efficiency of energy use, a power control system is proposed in this study. A lot of lighting power in communal lavatories is not managed and controlled that it is likely to be lit for 24 hours, once it is switched on. When there is no one using the lavatory but the lighting power is still on, abundant power waste is caused. If the number of people using the lavatory can be sensed and calculated as well as the lights can be automatically switched off when it is not in-use, the power could be economized for quality power management and waste preclusion. Moreover, if the data of power utilization could be transmitted to the server host and recorded in the database with remote connection, not only could the situation and the characteristics of power utilization be analyzed, but the switch time could also be intelligently self-regulated.

articleTitle: The estimated methodology for military software support cost
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The general model of military software support cost is built and analyzed. Post Deployment Software Support (PDSS) is divided into two parts, one is Software Running Support (SRS), the other is Software Maintenance Support (SMS). The cost of SRS is broken down into units and the general expression of SRS cost is put forward. The COCOMOII (Constructive Cost Model) is introduced. Then, it is improved to be adapted to the military software support. The procedure of estimating military software support cost is simplified, and the estimated result is accurate for the decision maker.

articleTitle: The performance loss analysis of foreign capital M&A
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The article holds the opinion that cross-border mergers and acquisitions (short for "M&A") may lead to production concentration and monopoly in a lager range. Monopoly could bring the waste of social resource and the loss of social welfare and social efficiency. The article analyses a series of products produced by M&A with the Williamson Heuristic Model. And it finds M&A arouses industrial concentration, impels market concentration, makes the M&A side have an increasingly control to the marketing, causes a certain monopoly and it also does harm to the social welfare.

articleTitle: Chinese stock bid-ask spread estimation and industry analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Bid-ask spread is an important indicator of market liquidity. In order to explore the characteristics of stock bid-ask spread in their industry and their changes over time mode. This paper uses Corwin(2010)'s new approach to estimate bid-ask spread, deal with the day's high and low price to calculate the spread, programmed and computed nearly 20 years and containing almost all of the stocks, importantly, categorized and analyzed the stock spread according to its industry property. Shanghai's spread was significantly lower than the Shenzhen's. And the spread show greater volatility when market ups or downs. However, the standard deviation of bid-ask spread in the whole time was gradually reduced. Different industries' bid-ask spread were highly relevant, but its variance were significant differences. By the impact of industrial policy, industries' bid-ask spread changed largely over the year.

articleTitle: The development of data analysis in intelligent decision support system based on ontology
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The deployment of the semantic web depends on the rapid and efficient construction of the ontology. Ontologies also play an important role in biomedical informatics and in knowledge management. Ontology arouses widespread concern in the artificial intelligence domain and it has been applied extensively. IDSS add artificial intelligence (AI) functions to traditional DSS with the aim of guiding users through some of the decision making phases. In this paper, the development of data analysis in intelligent decision support system(IDSS) based on ontology are proposed. The experimental results indicate that this method has great promise.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Optimization of the VV&A process of system based on the HLA
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The analysis of information flow network between different careers
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: We construct information flow network between different careers in Micro-blog. After analyzing we found that the network has cluster, small world, highly polarized features, etc. These characteristics make the information spreads more efficiency among different careers than any other online social network, the careers performance characteristics of information flow in Micro-blog is similar as in actual society.

articleTitle: Graduation design process inspired by classical principles of software engineering
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The classical principles of software engineering include life-cycle plan, paying attention to the value of all stages, postponed implementation and so on. Graduation project is an important means of testing the learning outcomes in college., Graduation project should be completed as a large software project, based on guiding ideology of the classical software engineering principles. So can we achieve the goal of improving the graduation quality.

articleTitle: A comparison method on the effect of AIDS drug cocktail therapy based on KSF analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper applies KSF analysis to compare four kinds of the common efficacy of AIDS drug cocktail therapy. First we decided on relevant key factors, Secondly the AIDS patients will be divided into different groups of patients according to the key factors and we choose young patients who are having serious illness from the groups as our research subject. Then we make four models about curative effect of AIDS" cocktails" therapies direct at the group of younger patients who are having serious AIDS by the theory of multiple regression analysis. Finally, we compare four AIDS cocktail therapies and solve the model by SPSS statistics software, thereby we provide a method to get the best plan for medical treatment for "young serious illness group".

articleTitle: Application of Web data mining in integrated marketing of musical instrument
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This paper introduces the integrated marketing of the musical instrument on the website and Web data mining technology. It analyses the application of Web data mining technology in the integrated marketing of the musical instrument on the website. Taking example of one musical instrument store on Tao Bao online mall, canopy clustering technique can be adopted to classify the end users to get the efficient and individual sales strategy.

articleTitle: Application of college physics teaching based on computer simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In college physics teaching, guiding students to use computer simulation is not only a new connotation of computer aided physics teaching, but also a product combined computers with college physics course. From the perspective of the computer simulation technology-assisted teaching college physics and according to cognitive learning theory, constructivist theory, psychological theory and university physics teaching the theory, this paper explains the basis of these theories in computer simulation technology-assisted university physics teaching application, and puts forward its own point of view. In the end, on the basis of examples, the paper conducts the research on computer simulation technology-assisted teaching of physics, showing preponderance of the use of computer simulation methods to solve complex physical problems.

articleTitle: Market-driven profit optimization for tabular chemical reactors with genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: With the uncertainty in the prices of feedstock, energy and finished products, the profit optimization plays a critical role in making a chemical production enterprise more dynamic and flexible to adapt the changes in global marketplace. This paper presents the development of profit optimization solution with an integration of profit model and model-based genetic algorithm (GA) optimization, and its industrial case study on an ethanolamine (EA) production line. The proposed methodology and solution may also be applied to other chemical manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Design of standard managing system in clothes manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In this fast developing information era, it is the most efficient measure for a to accelerate the informatization, electronizaion, and intelligentization in the process of clothes making. According to preliminary investigation, the majority of domestic clothes companies rely on human in the process of input, graph making, checking, type setting, printing booklet, etc, which is inefficient, arbitrary. Our design of the standard managing system in clothes manufacturing process aims to realize informatization, electronization, convenience, and high-efficiency in the process of standard making and document keeping and thus improve product quality, reduce labor intensity, and promote scientific management.

articleTitle: K-L absolute information dispersion clustering model and application in evaluating water-saving irrigation program
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In view of the complexity of indexes for evaluating water-saving irrigation program, to resolve the incompatibility of the results of evaluating water-saving irrigation program, and to raise the distinguishment of the model of evaluating water-saving irrigation program, application of projection data distribution and normal distribution difference as projection index, an effective and general model, named as K-L absolute information dispersion clustering model was suggested. The Real Coding based on Accelerating Genetic Algorithm was used to find the best projective direction, and the data of the best projective direction to research the level of the influence of each factor to water-saving irrigation program, the classification results according with the fact were got, which provided the decision reference for water-saving irrigation program.

Author Keywords: K-L absolute information dispersion clustering model
Real Coding based on Accelerating Genetic Algorithm

articleTitle: Production management of equipment supply chain based on SoftMan
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In the process of armored equipment supply chain management, it's an important research content how to improve the turnover efficiency of armored equipment, reduce the stock cost, arrange production flow rationally, reduce the stocks of armored equipment, establish distribution plan and transportation scheme, save unwanted expenditure and serve better for the armored equipment management. SoftMan is a new agent who can do something independently, at the same time, it has some Artificial Life characteristics, such as learning, evolution, inheritance and variation. This paper discusses Softman technique application in equipment supply chain management and stresses production plan and production control in detail.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the uncertain path optimization of considering multi-modal transportation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Hybrid STAP algorithm of sub-CPI method and covariance matrix taper for subspace leakage reduction
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The clutter subspace leakage phenomena in Space-Time Adaptive Processing (STAP) method results in expending the clutter ridge and increasing the effective rank of interference so that more sample supports are required. Therefore, a modified STAP method by combining the sub-Coherent Processing Interval (CPI) STAP method and the covariance matrix taper (CMT) method is proposed to deal with the subspace leakage in this paper. The proposed method can give better performance and robustness comparing with the traditional sub-CPI STAP method using the same sample supports. The availability of the proposed method is demonstrated by the simulations.

articleTitle: Comprehensive warning decision-making method of the operational bus based on typical dangerous working conditions
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Frequent occurrence of traffic accidents, especially large bus accidents with many casualties has become a focus of scientific study. In view of this, a comprehensive warning decision-making method is proposed, based on typical dangerous working conditions of the operational bus. Through the study of active safety technology, the data of typical dangerous working conditions of large buses is obtained. After the collection and procession of relevant driving parameters from vehicle sensors, the comprehensive early warning decision-making matrix is built. Thus, the early warning function is achieved by predicting whether the bus is in dangerous condition. The effect and feasibility of the method have been validated by tests and simulations. The results demonstrate that typical dangerous working conditions can be recognized accurately and the false alarm rate is less than 10% through the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese web relevance evaluation based on lexical chains
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Web relevance is one of the important indicators to reflect website characteristics from the semantic perspective. To users and constructors of the website, whether web relevance is good or not will affect their use and construction of the website. This paper makes use of the keywords extraction method for web page content and web relevance comparison way to do the research of Chinese web relevance evaluation. A small-scale experiment has been done to verify the feasibility of this evaluation method.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on the balance model of endowment insurance fund
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Based on the actuarial theory of endowment insurance, aiming at the replacement rate and balance between income and expenditure of endowment insurance, the model needs to be established to do the research. The worker data of a company in Shandong Province are taken as an example to analyze the condition pension target substitution rate and the balance between income and expenditure influenced by indexes, and constructive suggestions are given.

articleTitle: How to use “Cool Edit Pro 2.1” to measure L2 oral fluency
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The software “Cool Edit Pro 2.1” has long been considered and used as a music editor, and very few people know its application in English learning and teaching research. In this paper, in order to measure the second language learners' oral fluency, the reseracher tries this software in an empirical study and proves that “Cool Edit Pro 2.1” can measure the second language learners' oral fluency very accurately and efficiently. The research has up to now provided the readers with the most accurate and time-saving way of measuring temporal indices in L2 oral fluency, and this study reveals the tendency of the development of L2 oral fluency for Chinese non-English majors in the classroom setting and the evidence proves that the use of lexical chunks facilitates L2 oral fluency significantly. With the help of the software“Cool Edit Pro2.1”, the study explores linguistic features of oral fluency and provides the momentum to reach English fluency.

articleTitle: The personnel system reform in Chinese universities
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Personnel system reform in the domestic is being taken in almost all the universities in China. The paper, based on the new situation arisen in university personnel system reform, puts forward some suggestions on how to deepen the university personnel system reform after analyzing the existing problems and introducing some valuable experience and practice. The suggestions include concept conversion, responsibilities distinguish, favorable reform external environment foundation, supervision strengthening and the personnel system reform combination with the teaching reform.

articleTitle: Effect of manager shareholding on performance of listed companies: Based on the assumption that the private return of the manager shall be larger than the return on equity
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The core of listed company governance is to improve company performance and protect investors' benefits. Professional manager is the direct operator for a company, who directly affects company performance. Moreover, the shareholding percentage of professional manager may directly affect manager's performance. Accordingly, this thesis researches on how the managerial discretion effects on the corporate performance in different level of manager shareholding. It aims to reach a conclusion of the effect between managerial discretion and corporate performance in theory and makes use of the public data which come out from parts of the listed companies of our country to support the conclusion by demonstration, which may provide a referential basis for listed companies on decision making related with manager shareholding level.

articleTitle: Residents' perceptions and attitudes toward the impact of tourism
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: To investigate residents' perception is a good method to study the character and degree of tourism impacts. This paper takes Shangzhi as example, on the basis of on-the-spot survey, studies residents' perception of the economic, socio-cultural, environmental impacts of tourism and resident' attitudes to tourism development, and had some useful discussions.

articleTitle: Study on college basketball course network platform
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Sports teaching is an important part of university curriculum. As an elective course, the basketball class should become the emphasis of the teaching reform. Through the teaching contrast, the conclusion comes as no surprise that the college basketball course network platform is necessary and efficient.

articleTitle: Estimation of subsurface vertical thermal structure from sea surface temperature
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Based on a layered structure of temperature fields (mixed layer, thermocline, and lower layers), the parametric model transforms a vertical profile into several parameters: sea surface temperature (SST), mixed layer depth (MLD), thermocline bottom depth (TBD), thermocline temperature gradient (TTG), and deep layer gradient (DPG). These parameters vary on different timescales: SST and MLD on scales of minutes to hours, TBD and TTG on months to seasons, and DPG on an even longer timescale. If the long timescale parameters such as TBD, TTD, and DPG are known (or given by climatological values), the degree of freedom of a vertical profile fitted by the model reduces to one: SST. When SST is observed, one may invert MLD, and, in turn, the vertical temperature profile with the known long timescale parameters: TBD, TTG, and DPG. The U.S. NCEP Pacific Ocean Analysis Data Set for the northwest Pacific Ocean was used for the study, the latitude is 5N and the longitude is from 122E to 180E. The dataset excluding the test data is the training dataset. The training dataset (1993-2005) was processed into a dataset consisting of SST, MLD, TBD, TTG, and DPG using the parametric model. SST from the test dataset was used for the inversion based on the known information on TBD, TTG, and DPG. The inverted profiles of January 2006 agreed quite well with the corresponding observed profiles. The rms error is 0.780C, this is much better than the simple method of estimating subsurface temperature anomaly from SST anomaly by correlating the two in the training dataset.

articleTitle: Express logistics informatization problems discussion
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: With the advent of informatization and competition era, it is increasingly needed for high service quality and efficiency of the express logistics, implementing informatization construction of the express logistics is a efficiency way to improve business efficiency and service quality. Enterprises to implement informatization should be principled on "overall planning, gradual implementation, efficiency instigated and focus on key point". Express logistics information system applications including warehouse management, transportation management, financial settlement and decision support functions, it is able to adapt to express logistics more network, the requirements of the network operation, to solve the cargo "tourism" and remote financial settlement issues.

articleTitle: Ontology based user model for personalized agriculture search
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The paper proposes a user interest model based on user query keywords expanding, using information contained in an ontology for agriculture search engine, so more personalized search results can be returned by search engine with user interest model. Every user interest model for each user contains several sets of concepts, which are expanded from keywords submitted by user in the past period of time based on agricultural category ontology, and pruned based on user browsing behavior to reduce the model size to accelerate the response of search engine. Finally, the approach has been successfully implemented in a module of agriculture search engine SOUNONG1 which helps the system improve the relevance of responses to user queries.

articleTitle: Bytecode-based software monitoring and trusted evolution programming framework
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Point to reliability of distributed software in open complex environment, this paper proposes a bytecode-based software monitoring and trusted evolution programming framework, which injects monitoring ability and evolution ability into the software in construction and running phase. The framework is comprised of three module, business-logic and monitor-requirement description module (BMDM), monitoring capability infusing module (MCIM), and online evolution module (OEM), BMDM provides monitoring requirement expression language MRL+, MCIM compiles monitoring requirements monitoring requirement into aspect code, insert aspect code into source system by bytecode-based AOP technology, generate the target system with monitoring ability, and send monitoring information to OEM by event. OEM compares the state event with predefined evolution rules, when the predefined rules are triggered, perform the evolution actions, achieve real-time system's monitoring and correction. Finally, actual cases are analyzed to show that the framework can construct reliability software with monitoring ability and evolution ability efficiently.

articleTitle: Decision mechanism for chain to chain collaboration in cluster supply chains
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of chain to chain horizontal collaboration in cluster supply chains, this paper addresses remain/leave (R/L) decision mechanism for cluster supply chains when an enterprise or a set of enterprises needs to evaluate the anticipated reward of enterprise collaboration. In this research, a set of enterprises forms a collaborative network (CN) for the purpose of sharing their demands and capacities by predefined protocols. An enterprise in the CN determines remain decision with the CN when the collaborative condition of the enterprise has been altered. On the other hands, the CN determines a leave decision with a member enterprise of the CN when its performance impairs entire enterprise collaboration. Experimental results indicate that a single enterprise always prefers to remain in the CN in terms of demand fulfillment rate and total profit.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the maintenance management performance appraisal of oil equipments based on fuzzy AHP method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Quality evaluation system of website information services management: A comparison between ITIL and CSI
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: It is very apparent to find out the advantages and limitations of ITIL and the CSI Quality Evaluation System of Website Information Services Management. This research compared and synthesized the two, complemented each other, the establishment of a more comprehensive and systematic Quality Evaluation System of Website Information Services. Not only through "self-assessment" of the data we known their own lack, then improved; can also through "peer assessment", obtained their own invisible inadequacies and proposed, actively absorbed and reasonably adopted, to made the Website, Information Services Management move closer to users.

articleTitle: New honeypot system and its application in security of employment network
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to overview the honeypot and honeynet technologies, based on thorough analysis of the deficiency of obtain employment information network's security their concealment and security, a design of high concealed and high safe honeypot system has to be implemented successful. In the end, this paper validates the systematic design by performing the experiments.

articleTitle: SSH and its application in auction system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: For the complexity of EJB in development of J2EE applications, this paper describes a lightweight framework-SSH(Struts+Spring+Hibernate) in development of J2EE applications. Based on the concise analyzation of Struts and Spring and Hibernate, this paper discusses the merit of the Struts+Spring+Hibernate integrated framework, then describes its applications in an auction system.

articleTitle: The application of statistical computation for fitting the global sea temperature
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: We present the statistical fittings for global sea temperatures using the data of the World Ocean Atlas (WOA). We have gridded fittings for annual, monthly, and seasonal means of temperatures on standard levels (typically at 33 depths). To decrease bias, we apply the statistical regression models which combine the high-order polynomials with the mutually orthogonal polynomials. The comparison of the fitted results with the data of WOA are given, which demonstrate the accurateness of the fitted results.

articleTitle: “Transportation Economic GIS of Civil Aviation” based on COM GIS
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The platform of "Transportation Economic GIS of Civil Aviation" is sub-product of civil aviation execution operation management and GIS technology. It can manage and visually analyze the information and data of air-transportation resources about distribution of cities, airlines, airports, ability of transportation, and other air-lines based on geography range [1].

articleTitle: The driving coaches' professional eligibility evaluation from the perspective of gray clustering theory
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The quality of training for the driving school is not only related with cars driving skills of coaches, but also closely with the psychological factors, safety awareness, language skills and so on. Based on the relative raw data collected from the coaches in driving school, this paper develops automobile driving coaches professional eligibility evaluation index system. It uses gray clustering analysis theory to analyze and verified this index system and give a example to demontraste the evaluation method's feasibility.

articleTitle: Individual Intelligent Teaching System under the network environment
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Individual Intelligent Teaching System (Individual Intelligent Teaching System, IITS) is the effective way to carry out individual study. This paper discusses the concept, system structure and function of IITS, deeply researches the knowledge model, student model and teaching model and so on, constructs a intelligent teaching system Under the network environment.

articleTitle: The application of VAR model in the empirical study on steel futures price discovery
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: In order to discuss the price discovery function of steel future, this paper made an empirical study with weekly data of rebar future price and spot price, which was by means of Johansen cointegration test, Granger causality test, Variance decomposition and Impulse response function basing on VAR model. It was found that there was long-run equilibrium relationship and Granger leading relationship between the two price series. Furthermore, it was proved that futures price shares a higher part of total variance than spot price by variance decomposition, and in short term both the future price and spot price made a stronger reaction to the standard difference innovation of future price than that of spot price. Therefore, this article illuminated that rebar futures plays a more important role in price discovery.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy matter-element model based on entropy weight coefficient method in evaluation of comprehensive governance modes on sloping farmland
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Fuzzy matter-element was applied to evaluate comprehensive governance modes on sloping farmland and established a fuzzy matter-element model based on entropy weight coefficient method. In this model, take the comprehensive governance modes as matter-element things and construct compound fuzzy matter-element using the evaluation indexes and the corresponding fuzzy values of several modes. It can avoid the problem of weight allocation effectively that using the utility value which reflected the date themselves by information entropy. Finally, it will achieve sorting and selection of the best in all modes by comparing Euclid approach degree. From the evaluation of the comprehensive governance modes (conventional tillage, subsoiling + mole drain, subsoiling + furrow damming, subsoiling + mole drain + pipe drain, subsoiling + mole drain + furrow damming, subsoiling + mole drain + pipe drain + furrow damming), the result showed that subsoiling + mole drain + pipe drain + furrow damming was the best mode.

articleTitle: Research on effect evaluation of importing advanced technology & equipment in China
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The paper proposes Trade Balance Effect Model and Economic Spillage Effect Model of importing advanced technology and equipment, then demonstrates China's trade balance effect and economic spillage effect of importing advanced technology & equipment from 1995 to 2009 according as models.

articleTitle: Theory and practice about improvement teaching effect on heat transfer with computer technology application
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: The paper gives an introduction about improvement of teaching effect and discusses the methods about promoting students' interests, innovative ability and capability to solve practical problems in theoretical and experimental teaching on heat transfer course by using computer technology.

articleTitle: Application of reservoir logging evaluation technology in TPT region of Yijianfang group
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Yijianfang group in TPT region belongs to the type of carbonate reservoir, which transverse changes greatly and strong heterogeneity. In this region it has difficulties in reservoir and fluids properties recognition. In order to determine the reservoir limit parameters, according to carbonate reservoir and the reservoir characteristics in this area, we have established a set of carbonate reservoir parameter calculation model based on the core analysis data and test data of carbonate reservoir which suitable for yijianfang group in TPT area. This model provides reliable material for description of internal parameter distribution and form 3d data volume of reservoirs finally. These studies achieved good effect in the production, and provide reliable basis for further exploration, exploit and increase production measure of oil field.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on Zhejiang urbanization level and its influencing factors
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Robotics and Applications (ISRA)
abstract: Compared with other areas of the country, the urbanization level of Zhejiang is comparatively high. The paper first makes a cluster analysis on the urbanization level of 11 prefecture-level cities in Zhejiang; then it makes a quantitative analysis on the factors that influence urbanization. The result shows that three indexes namely the proportion of the secondary industry and tertiary industry in GDP, employment proportion of the tertiary industry and employment proportion of non-state sectors that reflect labor force transfer space have the greatest impact; the proportion of market allocation of resources and proportion of investment in fixed assets in GDP has relatively large impact. Finally it proposes countermeasures and suggestions for promoting the urbanization process of Zhejiang.
